title: National Medical Commission (NMC) Disclosures
subtitle: Mandatory statutory disclosures, government approvals, and department-wise faculty details in accordance with NMC norms.

sections.title: Government Approvals & NMC Recognition
details: Government of Maharashtra Letter of Intent (LOI) and Establishment Notification.
National Medical Commission (NMC) permission for 100 undergraduate (MBBS) seats annually.
Compliance status reports for annual renewal of permission.

sections.title: Department-Wise Faculty & Staffing
details: Comprehensive faculty roster for Pre-Clinical, Para-Clinical, and Clinical departments.
Teaching staff qualification verification and NMC faculty ID mappings.
Biometric attendance records and teaching faculty distribution.

sections.title: Hospital Clinical Material & Infrastructure
details: Daily OPD/IPD turnout census and bed occupancy rates.
Major and minor surgical operation statistics.
Radiological and central laboratory investigation volumes.
